_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/counters/test_cant_have_counters.py. t_chc_ward is Darksteel Angel's and Melira's prohibition on an enchantment, so the creature filter is the only thing between it and its own source; t_chc_bear is a plain creature, t_chc_withered a 4/4 that enters with two -1/-1 counters, t_chc_shrinker a creature whose ability costs a -1/-1 counter on itself, t_chc_rock a noncreature artifact the filter must miss.

cards.name: Test Counter Ward
cards.oracle_text: Creatures you control can't have -1/-1 counters put on them.

abilities.text: Creatures you control can't have -1/-1 counters put on them.

cards.name: Test Withered Hulk
cards.oracle_text: This creature enters with two -1/-1 counters on it.

cards.name: Test Shrinking Sage
cards.oracle_text: Put a -1/-1 counter on this creature: You gain 1 life.
